_comment: One turn whose only tool call fails: a read of a file that does not exist. The harness does not retry it, so the transcript must show the read card with its Error, never 'Retrying…' (#335). Used by web-tool-error.mjs. The next model request, which carries the failed result, is answered after 4 s (delayMs), so the drive can look at the failed step while it is still the live end of the transcript.
